[[Hops Flameinator]] is an [[Inferno Imp]] [[boss]] in [[Talmark Wilderness]].

== Locations ==
* [[Kryta]]
** {{NPC location|Talmark Wilderness}}

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Lava Font}}
* {{skill icon|Mark of Rodgort}}
* {{skill icon|Phoenix}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Lump of Charcoal]]

== Notes ==
* Hops does not always appear, so capturing Mark of Rodgort may require rezoning, which is faster using the Western (Majesty's Rest) exit.
* Though the surrounding imps inflict [[fire damage]] with their [[attack]]s, Hops does not.

== Trivia ==
* This boss is most likely named in reference to [[w:Trogdor|Trogdor The Burninator]], particularly since it possesses [[Mark of Rodgort]].
